title: raea source build and headless hello.tsx render to MP4 and PNG stills
summary: Pinned raea commit built from source with cmake 4.5.1; the manual's hello.tsx renders headlessly to 90-frame 1080x1920 H.264 and PNG stills. Probes, hashes, rerender and shuffled stills pass. Run 1 (no cmake) is in the README.
